title: Isolation precautions

findings.title: Correct hand-hygiene advice is styled as an error or critical state
findings.problem: The coral border and danger-colored heading emphasize “C. diff: soap and water,” a correct precaution rather than an incorrect action or a defined critical state. This conflicts with the reserved coral meaning.
findings.fix: Use teal for the recommended action, or amber if the panel is intended as a caution about alcohol rub and spores.

assessment: No clinical or rendering blocker identified in the supplied isolation diagram. One minor palette-rule issue.
